_doc: Motedis' threaded plate (Gewindeplatte) for its B-type 6 mm slot, M5. Also sold in M4 and M6. Motedis gives no drawing and no hold.
name: slot-nut-6-motedis-m5-square

slot.rule: Motedis' B-type 6 mm slot (slot-6-motedis), whose nuts are Rexroth's family (its nut_family is slot-6-bosch)

nut_kind.rule: A plain threaded plate, slid into the slot (the page's words), a cheaper stand-in for the heavy nut

length.rule: Along the slot: 14 (the page gives 14 x 9 x 2,5 mm, L x B x H)

nut_entry.rule: Slid in from an open end of the slot

material.rule: Material as the product page names it

hold.rule: Half Rexroth's 6 mm sliding block (3000 N): a thin plate bends under the lips before a block does. An estimate until it is tested (Frames 2.13): the maker gives no figure for this nut
hold.source: Bosch Rexroth, Basic Mechanic Elements MGE 14.0 (3 842 540 392, 2019-07), page 3-4 to 3-9; the proof stress from the kit's m5 thread set (ISO 898-1)
